column1: # Per-unit budgets (docs/perf/budgets.md derives them). Tab-separated columns:
#   unit  cfg  lut  lutram  ff  dsp  bram36  mode
#   cfg   a configuration, or * for every configuration
#   lut   CLB LUTs (logic + LUTRAM + SRL), after opt_design; lutram: LUTs as distributed RAM
#   bram36  block RAM in RAMB36 equivalents (a RAMB18 is 0.5)
#   -     no budget for that metric (the value is reported and tracked, not judged)
#   mode  enforce: over budget is a failure of the run; track: report only (no budget yet,
#         or the configuration waits for a re-plan: the 3-wide builds, plan §8.5)
# Budgets are per core and after the §8.5 levers. Target (D18, docs/perf/budgets.md §1.1): v1
# (smt2) at 180 MHz and at most 95% of the XCK26, 111.3K LUTs (the S6 fill test closes v1 at
# 95.3%). The core line holds the 180 MHz room; the unit lines are still the 200 MHz split
# (103K at 88%), so a core whose units are all within budget has 4,120 LUTs to spare.
# tg_core's instances combine some plan rows: ex = rf + int (register file, bypass, ALUs,
# MUL/DIV), lsu_mmu = lsu + mmu, rob_csr = rob (ROB, commit, traps, CSRs, PMP); the
# rf/int/lsu/mmu/rob rows keep the plan's split for reference.
